Name: Sunflower
Description: A sunflower can grow ten feet tall in a single summer, turning its young head to follow the sun across the sky, a habit called heliotropism. One flower head holds a thousand tiny florets, each becoming a seed that feeds birds, bees, and people alike.
CreationReflection: The sunflower's whole posture is a picture of worship: face turned toward the light, all day, every day. We were made to orient our lives the same way, toward the Son.
Habitat: Fields and gardens in full sun, grown around the world.
